H623: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first

H413: near, with or among; often in general, to

H238: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen

H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)

H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity

H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H1993: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
H7878: to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter
H5848: to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish

H270: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)

H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue

H8141: a year (as a revolution of time)

H5058: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);

H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H1584: to end (in the sense of completion or failure)
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H7092: to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet)
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H7356: compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden

H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1897: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H5949: an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H1350: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.)
H2220: the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3130: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H2342: properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively, to wait, to pervert
H637: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
H7264: to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear)

H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)

H2687: properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H1534: a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled)
H215: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically)
H1300: lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword

H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)

H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H6119: a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army)
H5148: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
